title: When a sizing calibration factor applies
usedBy: Stage 4 sizing (Get-SizingCalibration) and the sizing-evidence importer (ConvertFrom-SizingEvidence)

history.change: First policy: the median of measured/predicted per tier and VM family, applied from 3 observations, clamped to 0.5-1.5.
history.reason: Few observations are not a trend (P5); revisit after the second engagement (Q4)

history.change: Added minPeakSessionsPerHost 3 and minBindingUtilization 0.4 for imported sizing evidence.
history.reason: Measured sessions per host are extrapolated linearly to the target utilization; a lightly loaded host pool would extrapolate too far to be evidence (P5).
